extra.reason: Implemented dual-sensor ingress: SyntheticFrameSource (test/dev only, no real capture backend in this container), DualSensorSynchronizer (hardware-timestamp align with <1-frame skew tolerance, raises SensorSyncError/SensorStarvedError, never silently drops), and RingBuffer (120-frame window, is_full/dropped_frame_count, raises FrameGapError/FrameReorderError). 17/17 unit tests pass incl. an integration test sustaining the 120-frame window through an injected NIR frame drop, and a test asserting the pipeline never opens a socket. See sandbox-handoffs/ocean-vision-v1-9x6.md for full details, spec-inconsistency note (sec 2 vs 4.1 frame rate), and what remains unbuilt (real V4L2/NIR capture backends).

Implemented LabNormalizer (src/ov1/preprocess/lab.py): CLAHE contrast stretch on a*/b* only, L passed through untouched. Self-check + unittest suite verify L bit-identical to unstretched conversion, a*/b* histogram range/std widened on synthetic turbid footage, and mutation is channel-selective. clip_limit/tile_grid_size are required constructor args (no default) per site-calibration rule. Full suite: 27 tests, OK.

Implemented: cv2.calcOpticalFlowPyrLK sparse tracker over L-channel with site-supplied pixel->metre homography, drift-tolerant re-seeding, and a synthetic-clip sanity check on known drift direction. 22 new tests pass; full suite 49/49.
DoLP computation, glare mask, and tests implemented and passing per acceptance criteria

Implemented InferenceTensorAssembler (src/ov1/tensor/assemble.py): stacks per-frame [L,a*,b*,DoLP] planes into the spec 4.2 (1,4,120,1080,1920) tensor, downscales via cv2.resize, fixed channel order documented via CHANNEL_ORDER constant, and attempts torch pin_memory() for the Jetson handoff (honestly reporting pinned=False + reason on this no-CUDA container). 87 tests pass in 0.392s including a real-4K-to-1080p smoke test and a network-isolation test. Filed 2 follow-up beads (ocean-vision-v1-0h8 ingress->tensor glue, ocean-vision-v1-3hw channel-scale normalization) for out-of-scope work discovered.
